pullRequests.body:
## Summary

```diff
- Node.js 26.13.0
+ Node.js 26.13.1
```

Update the development and CI runtime pin and the packaged Alpine image. The image uses the official Docker Hub manifest-list digest for `node:26.13.1-alpine3.24`. [Node.js security release](https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v26.13.1/)

## Release context

```release-log
version: 1
audience: users
summary: "Update the release-log container to Node.js 26.13.1."
impact: "The container includes fixes for seven High-severity Node.js vulnerabilities flagged by the image scan."
required_action: null
```

## Verification

- **Before** — Grype flagged seven High findings in the Node.js 26.13.0 binary in [PR #94's container-security run](https://github.com/lhajoosten/release-log/actions/runs/44617448375).
- **After** — Built the packaged image with `pnpm container:build`. With container networking disabled, `node --version` returned `v26.13.1` and the packaged CLI displayed help.
- The local container security gate passed with five Medium findings and zero High, Critical, or Unknown findings. Grype 0.121.2 used database v6.1.10, built 2026-11-19 18:41 UTC.
- The commit hook ran the same `pnpm check` suite as `pnpm verify` and passed all 814 tests and the documentation build. A concurrent standalone run timed out in the packed CLI test.

## Risks and limitations

This is a reversible runtime patch scoped to development, CI, and the packaged container. The CLI retains its existing Node.js compatibility range.
